messages.en: Is your finger still bleeding? Have you bandaged it?
Yeah, I've bandaged it. It only bled a little earlier. It's stopped now.
According to this rota, you're on the morning shift tomorrow, right?
Yeah, I've checked. I start at seven tomorrow.

senses.en_definition: To stand upright on one's feet; to stand up.

collocations.en: stand in front of the door

senses.en_definition: To stand upright, fixed in place or held up by a support.
To be established or in existence, as a country or organization.
To be based on or sustained by something.

collocations.en: stand on one's own two feet

senses.en_definition: To originate or arise from something.

messages.en: I'm here, standing out front of this shop. Can you see me?
Can't see you yet. Are you by the entrance or next to the drinks stall?
Next to the drinks stall. I'm wearing a black shirt and waving at you.
I said a prayer earlier. Hopefully everything will go smoothly.
Amen. You've prepared for this, so just try to relax now.
